meaning:
ἐθνικός, -ή, -όν, [in Al.: Lev.21:7 * ;]
1. national (Polyb.).
2. foreign (gramm.); in NT, as subst., ὁ ἐ., the Gentile (the adj. "describes character rather than mere position"; cf. ἔθνος, and see Cremer, 228): Mat.5:47 6:7 18:17, 3Jo.7.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
